csv_project_name: Consultant for Carter County CDBG Project
csv_scope_of_work: Carter County requests qualifications for preliminary architectural services, cost estimate, subsequent design and construction inspection services to assist in a proposed construction project to be partially financed with FY26 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Community Facility funds. The proposed project consists of constructing a new community center that will also house the Fremont VFD. The project estimate eligible for CDBG funding will be equal to or less than the cap allowable amount of $500,000.
